status: prospective design and metadata reservation; NOT frozen for model execution
scope: Compare accumulated knowledge in repeated executable repository tasks; adapted VibeMemBench frozen-history track and separately named online extension, not an official upstream score.
validation_boundary: Metadata only inspected. No validation prompts, trajectories, patches or tests for development; existing unrelated reserved studies unchanged. Four tasks/one repository is a pilot, not confirmatory evidence.

tracks.frozen_history: Same cutoff-specific corpus/namespace and synchronous Add/Search boundary for all engines, no live updates across targets.
tracks.online_accumulation: Each arm retains only its own public evidence and admissible shared historical corpus; worktrees reset to prescribed target base; hidden evaluator outcomes never enter next task.
tracks.representation_ablation: Frozen pre-task snapshots with identical facts/evidence rendered graph vs flat. Report separately from divergent online trajectories.

models.native_memory_models: must be recorded and metered before execution; no assumption defaults are Luna

development_stages.initial_feasibility: First two reserved development targets, complete registered paired block; remaining three keep original order. Final arm/track matrix and budgets must be frozen before any model invocation.
development_stages.history: Latest eight strictly earlier same-repository benchmark-ordinal episodes per target; preserve complete tool/result pairs, explicitly record any truncation. Current/future target trajectories excluded.
development_stages.ordering: Fixed target ordinal sequence; deterministic rotating arm order within blocks; source hashes freeze at launch.
development_stages.larger_evaluation: Separate registration and powered multi-repository analysis after development, no tuning reserved validation or favorable-subset stopping.

required_freeze_fields: memory injection budgets and history chunking policy

execution_gates.status: blocked confirmed vulnerable base component; no installation/execution

pending per-environment own source read/write and private reference/test denial, network/credential isolation
pending maintained supported server review and deployment, native Luna LLM and embedding adapters; generic graph server is not equivalent

pending all normal and background model endpoint capture and response reconciliation, no unknown usages silently zeroed
pending software checks, budgets and all source manifest hashes; no frozen model assignments yet

leakage_controls.history_temporality: issue ordinals are upstream proxy, not verified PR timestamps; strict less-than enforced

quality: Independent target plus regression verification after positive/negative controls; report paired gains/losses, public checks distinct from hidden grades.
economics: All preparation, extraction, reflection, retrieval LLM, solver, integration and consolidation included. Initialization amortized over actual observed tasks only. Native/cached/output counters deduplicated. Cash/quota unknown; local embedding/deployment money separate.
statistics: Descriptive paired development and four-task validation pilot only. No population noninferiority or broad generalization claim from one repository per split.
no_retries: Zero automatic retries. Never repeat started or uncertain model calls; proven pre-inference preparation failures require explicit versioned amendment. Retain all failures and unknown counters.
success_target: Lower full task model inference cost with no observed quality loss; aspiration, not guaranteed or established result.
